newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ABR Holdings to set up restaurant company.
newsitem.headline: ABR Holdings to set up restaurant company.

text.p: ABR Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it has invested in a Singapore company to operate a brewery and restaurant in Singapore and in Southeast Asia.
It said in a statement it had invested in Brewerkz Singapore Pte Ltd, which had an initial paid-up capital of Singapore $294,100, comprising 294,100 ordinary shares of par value SS1.00 each.
The other shareholders were Brewerkz Investments Singapore Ptd Ltd (BI), BT Asia Pacific Ltd (BT) and Regent Universal Investments Ltd (Regent Universal).
BI will hold the 294,100 shares comprising its paid-up capital, the statement said.
It said that following the March 17 agreement, Brewerkz's authorised share capital would be raised to S$4 million.

Of Brewerkz' enlarged issued share capital of S$3.5 million, ABR will subscribe for 40 percent, or 1.4 million shares. BI will take 24 percent, including its existing shares, BT 16 percent and Regent Universal 20 percent.
ABR intends to finance the investment by bank borrowings and or through the company's internally generated sources.
It said Brewerkz would set up a microbrewery and restaurant in Singapore, adding to its existing interest in Swenson's outlets and Georgie's restaurant.
The investment was not expected to have any significant impact on the earnings or net tangible assets of the company for the financial year ending December 31, 1997, the statement said.
